# Config: Input

> **Reader:** `InputConfig` (`config/InputConfig.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.Input` · category Compositor

Input: Keyboard, mouse, touchpad and cursor. A part that's on wins over your compositor's own config; the login screen follows it too.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.
